title: Maester Pack manifest (maester-pack.json)
description: Describes a Maester Pack: its identity, its tests, helpers and connectors, and what it reaches. See https://maester.dev/docs/packs/writing-a-pack. Maester checks the manifest itself when a pack is installed and loaded; this schema helps editors.

Id.description: <publisher>.<name> in lower case, for example contoso.google-workspace.

Guid.description: A GUID that identifies the pack for good, such as d1e2db80-6c27-4cb6-9389-2edf0a898d23. New-MtPack writes one. Keep it, and the code, for every version of the pack: a pack with a new code needs a new Guid.

Publisher.description: The GitHub user or organisation that owns the pack's repository.

License.description: An SPDX licence identifier, such as MIT.

RequiresMaester.description: The Maester versions the pack works with, such as '>=3.1 <4.0', '^3.1' or '~3.1.2'.

Code.description: The pack's code: every test ID of the pack starts with MP.<Code>. One to three parts separated by dots, each two to ten letters or digits starting with a letter, such as ZTA or CNT.GWS.

Suites.description: Folders of native tests inside the pack.

Helpers.description: Folders of .ps1 files with functions the tests call.

Exports.description: Functions that packs requiring this one may call.

EnabledByDefault.description: For a pack that ships with Maester: false leaves it off until the config turns it on.

Runtime.description: This version of Maester runs only PowerShell (Script) packs.

Catalog.description: A JSON file in the pack that lists its tests, for listings.

Banner.description: A .png, .jpg or .webp image in the pack, 1200 x 630, at most 1 MB.

Guide.description: A JSON file in the pack that says how to install, connect and run it, for its page on packs.maester.cloud. See https://maester.dev/schemas/maester-pack-guide-1.0.json.

Settings.description: The GlobalSettings keys the pack reads, each named Namespace.Key. Maester checks the run config against them, returns Default from Get-MtSetting when the config does not set one, and lets a pack test bind one with [MaesterParameter(Setting = 'Namespace.Key')]. See https://maester.dev/docs/packs/writing-a-pack#settings.

Default.description: The value Get-MtSetting returns when the config does not set the setting.

AllowedValues.description: The values a string or string[] setting accepts.

Kind.description: What a string holds, for example Entra.Group, so a user interface can offer a picker.

Sensitive.description: The value is redacted in the results.

Report.description: How the pack appears in the Maester report. See https://maester.dev/docs/packs/writing-a-pack#the-packs-menu-in-the-report.

Logo.description: A mark the report draws in the pack's page header instead of its Code: 'microsoft', or a product key such as 'entra'. The report draws it itself and loads no image from the pack.

Navigation.description: The pack's menu in the report. Each entry is a row (Title) or a section heading (Section) that opens one of the report's built-in views; any entry can hold Items, to any depth. Without it, the report builds a menu from the pack's tests.

Id.description: The entry's part of the page's link. Defaults to the Title or Section in lower case with dashes.

Section.description: A heading in the menu. Its rows are its Items, or the rows its view expands to.

View.description: pack: the pack's overview. tests: the pack's tests. plan: a JSON attachment drawn by a view the report ships. attachment: an HTML report the pack attached. guide: a page of the pack's guide. about: publisher, version and links.

Attachment.description: For plan and attachment: the Name the pack gave Add-MtReportAttachment.

Expand.description: For plan: the levels to list in the menu, such as ["pillars", "areas", "lanes"].

GroupBy.description: For tests: names of the tests' Fields, one menu level each, such as ["Pillar", "Category"].

Result.description: For tests: only tests with this result, such as Failed.

Filter.description: For tests: only tests whose Fields have these values.

Page.description: For guide: the page of the guide file to show.

uses.description: What the pack reaches, shown when it is installed. Unknown keys are refused.
